description: This Java class defines the GroupModel, which represents a group of services in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to initialize the group from an XML DOM element or directly via parameters, retrieve group details, and execute the services within the group in different modes (all, round-robin, random, first-available, none). The class also includes logic for handling service invocation order and processing the results.

classes.name: GroupModel
classes.description: Represents a group of services that can be invoked collectively with different execution modes. Provides mechanisms to load group configuration from XML, access group properties, and run contained services in modes such as all, round-robin, random, or first-available.

methods.name: GroupModel(Element group)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GroupModel instance from an XML DOM Element, parsing attributes and child service elements.

methods.name: GroupModel(String groupName, String sendMode, List<GroupServiceModel> services)
methods.description: Basic constructor that sets up the group with specified name, mode, and list of services.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service group.

methods.name: getSendMode
methods.description: Returns the mode used for invoking services within the group.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Returns the list of services contained within the group.

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Indicates whether the group is optional.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the services in the group based on the configured send mode, handling different modes such as all, round-robin, random, first-available, and none.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the GroupModel object.

methods.name: runAll
methods.description: Invokes all services in the group sequentially, merging results and handling errors.

methods.name: runIndex
methods.description: Invokes a single service at a specified index.

methods.name: runOne
methods.description: Invokes services sequentially until one succeeds or all fail, returning the first successful result.
